## Limits

- Questions are model-written on both sides; lexical overlap can favor BM25.
- The corpus contains the training passages, so this is retrieval generalization only.
- Gold cohorts are small and confidence intervals are not a substitute for replication.
- If BM25 remains ahead, this experiment does not claim fine-tuning wins.
- The reported Phase 4 recommended replay uses the same base vectors but a local weighted-fusion approximation; it is not a fresh Phase 4 rerun.
